function: p. 1: Probing beam optimization for probing-beam-measurement-based hybrid beamforming in cell-free MIMO, using learned PBM augmentation and sum-rate prediction to guide a genetic search.
system: p. 4: Cell-free MIMO, 3 APs with 8x8 UPA each serving 6 single-antenna users, hybrid beamforming, no RIS; 28 GHz carrier, 100 MHz bandwidth, one subcarrier sampled.
method: p. 3: CVAE with mixture density network (full covariance, Cholesky training) for PBM augmentation; DenseNet-type DNN sum-rate regressor (MMSE loss, p. 4); genetic algorithm. No federated, RL or meta-learning.
data_channel: p. 4: DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset, scenario O1, rows R1000 to R2051; 200 sets of random user locations in 6 regions; same dataset for training and testing.
test_conditions: p. 4-5: Fig. 3a-3b train on all 8 probing beam combinations (test size 100); Fig. 3c trains on 4 of 8 combinations and tests on the 4 unsampled ones.
baselines: p. 4-5: Learned: CVAE and VAE-and-MDN augmentation baselines. Non-learned: SBF exhaustive search over the entire beamspace as sum-rate reference.
metrics: p. 4-5: Maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) of augmented PBMs, CDF of predicted sum rate, rate-prediction error, optimal probing beam identification, sum rate relative to exhaustive SBF search.
complexity: p. 4: Numbers of parameters: 11,651,562 for the augmentation module and 969,301 for the rate-mapping module; no FLOPs or runtime.
openness: p. 4: none; the paper uses the public DeepMIMO dataset [19] and gives no link to its own code or data.
q1_support: p. 4: "we use the DeepMIMO channel dataset [19]" (ray-tracing, scenario O1), which is the accepted ray-tracing dataset.
q2_support: p. 5: "The remaining 4 probing beam combinations only have 100 test samples and no training samples"; probing beam combinations unseen in training are tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "are compared as baseline schemes" (CVAE, VAE-and-MDN, on MMD); p. 5: "approximately 90% of the sum rate attained by the SBF exhaustive search" (non-learned).
q4_support: p. 4: "The numbers of their total parameters are 11, 651, 562 and 969, 301, respectively" (augmentation and rate-mapping modules).
q5_support: p. 4: "we use the DeepMIMO channel dataset [19]"; public channel dataset, although the paper releases no code or link of its own.
notes: The PDF is the arXiv preprint 2409.13286v1 (20 Sep 2024). It prints no DOI, so the match with the DOI rests on the letter format and the date. Area 3 by function (probing beam optimization for hybrid BF); the PBM augmentation could also be read as channel synthesis (area 2). q3 is borderline: CVAE is called the traditional model (p. 1, ref. [13]) but is also the proposed model without the MDN, VAE-and-MDN is an ablation, and the non-learned reference is the full-beamspace exhaustive SBF sum rate (p. 5). q2 rests on the 4 unsampled probing beam combinations of Fig. 3c (p. 5), same DeepMIMO site and scenario.
